description: Audit one GitHub Actions workflow against a contract the caller states. The finding that needs two parts of the file at once: a privileged trigger such as pull_request_target together with a checkout of the contributor ref, which runs untrusted code with the base repository secrets. Also reports an action pinned to a mutable tag, a secret or author-controlled event field interpolated into a run command, an absent permissions block, and the trigger key read as a boolean. Pay 200000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

contract.description: The rules to apply. An unknown property here is refused rather than ignored.

require_concurrency.description: Report an absent concurrency group. Defaults to false.

require_explicit_permissions.description: Report an absent permissions block, where the token scope comes from a default set elsewhere. Defaults to true.

require_pinned_actions.description: Report an action pinned to anything other than a 40-character commit. Defaults to true.

require_timeout.description: Report a job with no timeout-minutes. Defaults to false.

trusted_action_owners.description: Owners whose tag-pinned actions are reported under their own code so a caller can treat them differently. Defaults to actions and github.

workflow.description: The workflow file. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
workflow.example:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - uses: some-vendor/deploy-action@v1
      - name: publish
        run: npm publish --token ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
      - name: label
        run: echo "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"

name: github_actions_workflow_audit

checked.description: Which checks ran, so a contract that switched everything off is visible rather than reading as a pass.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when the file parsed, nothing was left unaudited, and every check that ran found nothing.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: GitHub Actions Workflow Audit
